mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance p INNER JOIN evaluation e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id AND e.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} WHERE p.status = 'WAITING'

SELECT CONCAT(MONTH(base.target_date), '월') AS monthLabel, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(base.score, 0))) AS score FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at) AS target_date, COALESCE(mp.score, p.achievement_rate, 0) AS score FROM performance p LEFT JOIN monthly_performance mp ON mp.employee_id = p.employee_id AND mp.year = YEAR(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) AND mp.month = MONTH(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) ) base GROUP BY YEAR(base.target_date), MONTH(base.target_date) ORDER BY YEAR(base.target_date), MONTH(base.target_date)

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.feedback, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '등록된 피드백이 없습니다.') AS text, '시스템' AS author, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at), '%Y.%m.%d') AS date, p.performance_id AS inquiryItemId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS detail FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND (NULLIF(p.feedback, '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(p.comment, '') IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN 'Team' ELSE 'Individual' END AS type, p.title, LEFT(COALESCE(p.work_detail, ''), 24) AS coreTask, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d')) WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') END AS date, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ENDED' THEN '완료' WHEN p.status = 'WAITING' THEN '대기' ELSE '진행중' END AS status, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, e.employee_name AS employeeName, p.employee_id AS employeeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, ''), NULLIF(pp.result_summary, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '-') AS achievement FROM performance p INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id LEFT JOIN performance_personal pp ON pp.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT YEAR(base.target_date) AS scoreYear, MONTH(base.target_date) AS scoreMonth, ROUND(AVG(base.score)) AS score FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at) AS target_date, COALESCE(mp.score, p.achievement_rate, 0) AS score FROM performance p LEFT JOIN monthly_performance mp ON mp.employee_id = p.employee_id AND mp.year = YEAR(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) AND mp.month = MONTH(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) WHERE AND DATE(COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at)) >= #{windowStart} AND DATE(COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at)) < #{windowEndExclusive} ) base GROUP BY YEAR(base.target_date), MONTH(base.target_date) ORDER BY YEAR(base.target_date), MONTH(base.target_date)

SELECT YEAR(base.target_date) AS scoreYear, MONTH(base.target_date) AS scoreMonth, ROUND(AVG(base.score)) AS score FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at) AS target_date, COALESCE(mp.score, p.achievement_rate, 0) AS score FROM employee_hr_info target_info INNER JOIN employee_hr_info team_info ON team_info.org_id = target_info.org_id INNER JOIN performance p ON p.employee_id = team_info.employee_id LEFT JOIN monthly_performance mp ON mp.employee_id = p.employee_id AND mp.year = YEAR(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) AND mp.month = MONTH(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) WHERE target_info.employee_id = #{targetEmployeeId} AND DATE(COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at)) >= #{windowStart} AND DATE(COALESCE(mp.calculated_at, p.end_date, p.created_at)) < #{windowEndExclusive} ) base GROUP BY YEAR(base.target_date), MONTH(base.target_date) ORDER BY YEAR(base.target_date), MONTH(base.target_date)

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN 'team' ELSE 'individual' END AS type, p.title, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%m.%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%m.%d')) WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%m.%d') END AS date, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, COALESCE(mp.score, p.achievement_rate, 0) AS score, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, ''), NULLIF(pp.result_summary, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '-') AS achievement, NULLIF(COALESCE(p.feedback, p.comment), '') AS feedbackText, '시스템' AS feedbackAuthor, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at), '%Y.%m.%d') AS feedbackDate FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_personal pp ON pp.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN monthly_performance mp ON mp.employee_id = p.employee_id AND mp.year = #{targetYear} AND mp.month = #{targetMonth} WHERE AND YEAR(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) = #{targetMonth} ORDER BY COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at) DESC

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, e.employee_name AS user, o.org_name AS dept, p.title, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS date, '대기' AS status, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN '팀 성과' ELSE '개인 성과' END AS type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT(p.achievement_rate, '%') ELSE NULL END AS achievement, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress FROM performance p INNER JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.employee_id = p.employee_id AND ev.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info ehr ON ehr.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = ehr.org_id WHERE p.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE performance SET achievement_rate = COALESCE(#{progress}, achievement_rate), end_date = COALESCE(end_date, CURDATE()), status = 'ENDED', comment = COALESCE(#{comment}, comment) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId}

UPDATE performance_personal SET result_summary = COALESCE(#{resultSummary}, result_summary), growth_point = COALESCE(#{growthPoint}, growth_point), improvement = COALESCE(#{improvementPoint}, improvement) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId}
UPDATE performance_team SET team_result_summary = COALESCE(#{resultSummary}, team_result_summary), special_point = COALESCE(#{resultNote}, special_point) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId}

UPDATE performance SET status = 'ENDED', end_date = COALESCE(end_date, CURDATE()), feedback = COALESCE(#{comment}, feedback) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = performance.employee_id AND ev.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} )

UPDATE performance SET status = 'ACTIVE', feedback = COALESCE(#{comment}, feedback) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = performance.employee_id AND ev.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} )
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id AS id, e.employee_name AS name, COALESCE(j.job_name, '팀원') AS role, COALESCE(o.org_name, '소속팀') AS department, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_evaluation te_done WHERE te_done.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} AND te_done.appraisee_id = e.employee_id AND te_done.evaluation_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) ) THEN '완료' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance p_wait WHERE p_wait.employee_id = e.employee_id AND p_wait.status = 'WAITING' ) THEN '진행 중' ELSE '평가 대기' END AS status, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0))) AS systemScore, ROUND(AVG((COALESCE(pr.communication_score, 0) + COALESCE(pr.solving_score, 0) + COALESCE(pr.responsibility_score, 0) + COALESCE(pr.team_contribution, 0)) / 4), 1) AS peerReviewScore, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.communication_score, 0)), 1) AS performanceAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.responsibility_score, 0)), 1) AS attitudeAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.team_contribution, 0)), 1) AS collaborationAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.solving_score, 0)), 1) AS creativityAvg FROM employee_hr_info my_info INNER JOIN employee_hr_info member_info ON member_info.org_id = my_info.org_id AND member_info.employee_id != #{employeeId} INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = member_info.employee_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = member_info.job_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = member_info.org_id LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN peer_review pr ON pr.eval_id = ev.eval_id WHERE my_info.employee_id = #{employeeId} GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, j.job_name, o.org_name ORDER BY e.employee_name

SELECT e.employee_id AS id, e.employee_name AS name, COALESCE(o.org_name, '소속팀') AS team, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM peer_review pr WHERE pr.reviewer_id = #{employeeId} AND pr.eval_id IN ( SELECT ev.eval_id FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = e.employee_id ) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS evaluated FROM employee_hr_info my_info INNER JOIN employee_hr_info member_info ON member_info.org_id = my_info.org_id AND member_info.employee_id != #{employeeId} INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = member_info.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = member_info.org_id WHERE my_info.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY e.employee_name
SELECT ev.eval_id FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = #{appraiseeId} ORDER BY ev.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(o.org_name, '소속팀') AS teamName FROM employee_hr_info my_info INNER JOIN employee_hr_info member_info ON member_info.org_id = my_info.org_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = member_info.org_id WHERE my_info.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY teamName

SELECT e.employee_id AS id, e.employee_name AS name, COALESCE(j.job_name, '팀원') AS role, COALESCE(o.org_name, '소속팀') AS department, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0))) AS systemScore, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.communication_score, 0)), 1) AS performanceAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.responsibility_score, 0)), 1) AS attitudeAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.team_contribution, 0)), 1) AS collaborationAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.solving_score, 0)), 1) AS creativityAvg FROM employee_hr_info my_info INNER JOIN employee_hr_info member_info ON member_info.org_id = my_info.org_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = member_info.employee_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = member_info.job_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = member_info.org_id LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN peer_review pr ON pr.eval_id = ev.eval_id WHERE my_info.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND (#{teamName} IS NULL OR o.org_name = #{teamName}) GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, j.job_name, o.org_name ORDER BY e.employee_name

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.title, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ENDED' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_progress' END AS status, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM employee_hr_info my_info INNER JOIN employee_hr_info member_info ON member_info.org_id = my_info.org_id INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = member_info.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = member_info.org_id INNER JOIN performance p ON p.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE my_info.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND (#{teamName} IS NULL OR o.org_name = #{teamName}) ORDER BY e.employee_id, p.created_at DESC
